## Create our bucket
```sh
aws s3 mb s3://prefixes-fun-ld-1234
```

## Create our folder
```sh
aws s3api put-object --bucket="prefixes-fun-ld-1234" --key="hello/"
```

## Create many folder

```sh
aws s3api put-object --bucket="prefixes-fun-ld-1234" --key=""
```
## try and break the 1024 limit

```sh
aws s3api put-object --bucket="prefixes-fun-ld-1234" --key=".txt" --body="hello.txt"
```
